'''Holoplayers''' were handheld devices used to play and watch [[Holoshow/Legends|holoshows]]. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] bought one and used it to watch [[holothriller]]s of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
